build_label_list: build a label list by calling _mklbl with a prefix string and count to generate prefixed sequential labels

test_indexing_loc: test loc indexing on a pandas object with a given key and expected exception type

test_indexing_axis_1: test iloc and loc indexing on axis 1 of a pandas object with a specific key
